blocks.tamil_translation: narrates: Hazrat Ubadah ibn as-Samit (RA) said to his son, “My son! Until you firmly believe that any (good or bad) matter that reached you (in this world) could never (under any circumstances) have missed you, and that any (good or bad) matter that did not reach you could never (under any circumstances) have reached you, you cannot taste the true sweetness of Iman. (Continuing, to his son:) I have heard through the Prophet ﷺ that the first thing Allah created was the Pen. Then He commanded it to write. It asked, “O my Lord, what shall I write?’ Allah said, ‘Write all the (fixed) decrees for every thing that is to come until the Last Day!’ I also heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “My son! Whoever dies with a belief contrary to this is not of me!”” Hazrat Ubadah ibn as-Samit (RA) said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: وَكَّلَ اللهُ بِالرَّحِمِ مَلَكاً فَيَقُولُ: أَيْ رَبِّ نُطْفَةٌ أَيْ رَبِّ عَلَقَةٌ أَيْ رَبِّ مُضْغَةٌ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللهُ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ خَلْقَهَا قَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ ذَكَرٌ أَمْ أُنْثَي؟ أَشَقِيٌّ أَمْ سَعِيدٌ؟ فَمَا الرِّزْقُ؟ فَمَا اْلاَجَلُ؟ فَيُكْتَبُ كَذلِكَ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Allah has appointed an angel over the womb (of the mother). He keeps saying, “O my Lord, (now it) is a drop of semen; O my Lord! (now it) is a clot of blood; O my Lord, (now it) is a lump of flesh!” (Although Allah knows everything, that angel keeps informing Him of the various stages of the child.) When Allah wills to complete its form, that angel says, O my Lord! (Will this child be)
